tropical_outlook: NHC (Tue Oct 13, 2026): no active tropical cyclones in the Atlantic basin; advisories only in the Eastern Pacific (TD Twenty-One-E, Hurricane Simon). Hurricane Isaias (season's first hurricane) made landfall near Destin FL on Oct 9 as a Cat 2 and is over; lingering Southeast impacts were flooding/tornadoes last week, not this weekend. No named system or invest found that threatens Tampa, London, or the Gulf/East coast for Oct 15-19. Season has been quiet (strong El Nino shear). Sources: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/ ; https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/08/weather/live-news/hurricane-isaias-gulf-storm
